## Baseline: the sectioned prompt (2026-10-15)

The prompt in five sections (Role, When to act, Grounding, Preparing,
Replies), three runs per case, DeepSeek V4 Flash on the pinned hosts, the
current recording (recording 3 in the section below). The rows come from two revisions, because the
prompt was amended after most cases had run:

- 21 rows ran on 2595f0556c, the first version, since amended into
  e3f071d99a and on no branch. Its prompt also told the
  model how to settle a `skipped_confirmation` warning and to check the slice
  before exporting, and five tool descriptions were trimmed (`export_file`,
  `intent_update`, `project_open`, `settings_get`, `settings_preview_patch`).
  No case tests those sentences or descriptions. All its runs, the two
  `petg-restated` cases' included: 109 requests,
  1,245,738 input tokens (878,720 cached), 26,623 output, 18 judge calls.
- The two `petg-restated` rows ran on e3f071d99a, the prompt as merged: the
  tool descriptions as they were before, those two sentences gone, and two
  fixes for this pair of cases ("A request you already carried out,
  repeated: they are checking, so say what is in place." and "slice its
  plate"). Runs: 6 requests, 79,722 input tokens (50,176 cached), 2,265
  output.

| Case | Revision | Pass | Fail | Unobserved | What the other runs did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `advice-infill` | 2595f0556c | 2 | 0 | 1 | kept reading past three answers |
| `prepare-petg-strong` | 2595f0556c | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
| `after-preview` | 2595f0556c | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
| `after-apply` | 2595f0556c | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
----
| **Total** | | **54/69** | **5** | **10** | |

Against the paragraph prompt below: speaking of OrcaSlicer as another
program fell from 5 of 6 runs to 1 of 6, and the restated-intent pair passed
4 of 6 instead of 3 of 6, with no run slicing again. Answering from the
context did not change (1 of 3). The three extra unobserved runs are reads
this recording cannot answer, not changes.

The 21 rows from 2595f0556c are not a measurement of the merged prompt; a
run of those cases on e3f071d99a or later replaces them. The recording was
made at 336facf825, before 5cf784d30b changed how earlier turns are trimmed;
----
## Earlier baseline: the paragraph prompt (2026-10-15, kept as a record)

The prompt before the sections, `--prompt-rev 6b4b8b6188` (unchanged at 336facf825), three
runs per case, DeepSeek V4 Flash on the pinned hosts. Each row was measured
with one of three recordings, which hold the same conversations and differ
only in which reads they answer (and in ids). All three have the user
message of ebf723cbb6 or earlier, as the sectioned baseline above does.

1. 27 answers per point: `workspace_inspect`, `slice_report`,
   `printer_list`, about 100 print settings, the first object's, filament's
   and printer's common settings, hand-kept names, 16 searches. All 23 cases
   ran with it: 69 runs, 109 requests, 1,256,920 input tokens (925,696
   cached), 27,553 output, 15 judge calls.
2. Recording 1 plus `object_analyze` for the active plate's objects and 49
   searches. The seven cases with unobserved runs in recording 1 ran again:
   21 runs, 54 requests, 602,761 input tokens (451,584 cached), 17,912
   output, 6 judge calls.
3. Every setting of every scope and object, as the section above
   describes. The four cases still with unobserved runs ran
   again: 12 runs, 35 requests, 398,836 input tokens (279,296 cached),
   10,518 output, 3 judge calls.

| Case | Recording | Pass | Fail | Unobserved | What the other runs did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `advice-infill` | 2 | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
| `prepare-petg-strong` | 1 | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
| `after-preview` | 1 | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
| `after-apply` | 1 | 3 | 0 | 0 |  |
----
| **Total** | | **52/69** | **10** | **7** | |

Three runs a case catch a behaviour that happens often, not one that happens
once in twenty; differences of a run or two are noise. Every failure was read
and is the model's: speaking of OrcaSlicer as another program after the slice
warning (5 of 6 across `first-person` and its variant), checking the
workspace instead of answering from the context (2 of 3), and slicing or
reading again after an unchanged intent was restated (3 of 6). The
7 unobserved runs ended on a read the recording cannot answer: a
setting name that does not exist in OrcaSlicer, a search wording not
recorded, or a `target` sent as a string of JSON, which the app refuses.
`troubleshoot-first-layer` still observed no run: its reads differ every
time.

An earlier baseline the same day (18 cases, every read ending the run)
passed 39 of 54; it is not comparable.

drop = {"PetgRestated", "PetgRestatedAfterRead", "OmittedReplay", "IssueFixAfterRead",
        "LoadedVsConfiguredAfterRead", "FirstPersonAfterRead", "ReplyInGermanAfterRead"}
lines = src.split("\n")
ranges = sorted(((n.lineno, n.end_lineno) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name in drop), reverse=True)
assert len(ranges) == len(drop), ranges
for start, end in ranges:
    # also drop the blank lines that follow the class (two blank lines between defs)
    e = end
    while e < len(lines) and lines[e].strip() == "": e += 1
    del lines[start - 1:e]
    # keep exactly two blank lines before the next definition
    lines.insert(start - 1, ""); lines.insert(start - 1, "")
src = "\n".join(lines)
src = re.sub(r"\n{3,}(?=class |def |CASES|# ---)", "\n\n\n", src)
for name in drop:
    src = re.sub(r"\b" + name + r",\s*", "", src)
src = src.replace("RUN_BUDGET = 72", "RUN_BUDGET = 48")
assert "3 each for 24 cases" in src
src = src.replace("3 each for 24 cases", "3 each for 16 cases")

The seven cases are gone from the suite, its recordings and its README, and the offline checks pass. The changes are uncommitted on a new branch `claude/prompt-case-cleanup` in this worktree.

**What I verified before deleting the after-read variants.** Each variant started one read after its parent case, and the parent now answers that same read from its own recording. I compared, for each parent, the recorded answer the runner would hand the model against the real result the model's read got when the variant was recorded:

- `issue-fix`: the settings read on the issue's object returns first layer 0.5 mm and layer height 0.2 mm, the same values. The ids differ because each point is recorded in its own replay, which is why a naive lookup with the variant's object id finds nothing; with the parent's own object ids, both objects have answers.
- `loaded-vs-configured`: the printer list answer is empty in both, as the case needs.
- `first-person`: the three support settings match exactly; only the session id and revision differ.
- `reply-in-german`: summary, intent and plan match; the objects section differs only in plate ids.

**What changed, all under `tests/project_prompt`:**

- `run_prompt_tests.py`: the seven case classes and a stale comment about the variants are removed; the run budget is now 51 runs, three for each of the 17 remaining cases.
- `test_steps.py`: one step test pointed at `petg-restated`; it now uses `issue-fix` with an out-of-scope preview in second place.
- `script.json`: the "like I said, PETG and strong." step, the start G-code conversation and the scripted reads that only led to the variants are gone.
- `requests.json`: the seven recorded points are gone. The remaining 17 cases and the shared setting items are byte-identical to before, so the schema drift test's outcome is unchanged. The file shrinks from 3.9 MB to 3.4 MB.
- `README.md`: the case rows, the two notes about the variants and the omission note, the run budget, the "24 points" count, and both baseline tables are updated. Totals are recomputed from the surviving rows (37 of 48 for the sectioned prompt, 38 of 48 for the paragraph prompt) and the two sentences that quoted the restated-intent and omitted-replay results are gone.

**Checks run:** the 13 offline step tests pass, and `--render-only` renders all 17 requests. I did not run the C++ schema drift test, since it needs a build and the recordings it checks did not change. No live model request was made.

**Not done, by design:** the prompt still contains "A request you already carried out, repeated: they are checking, so say what is in place." You did not ask for the sentence to go in this task, and nothing measures it now. Nothing is committed.

import importlib.util, json, pathlib, re
HERE = pathlib.Path("tests/project_prompt")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("run_prompt_tests", HERE / "run_prompt_tests.py")
runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
def strip_ids(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        return {k: strip_ids(v) for k, v in x.items() if k not in ("id","objectId","plateId","plateIds","sessionId","revision","actionId","activePlateId","selectedObjectIds")}
    if isinstance(x, list): return [strip_ids(v) for v in x]
    return x
pairs = {"issue-fix": "issue-fix-after-read", "loaded-vs-configured": "loaded-vs-configured-after-read",

for parent, child in pairs.items():
    inp = runner.REQUESTS[child]["body"]["input"]
    call = [i for i in inp if i.get("type") == "function_call"][-1]
    real = json.loads(next(i for i in inp if i.get("type") == "function_call_output" and i["call_id"] == call["call_id"])["output"])
    args = json.loads(call["arguments"])
    if "target" in args and "objectId" in args["target"]:

        text = "\n".join(p.get("text","") for i in runner.REQUESTS[parent]["body"]["input"] if i.get("role")=="user" for p in (i["content"] if isinstance(i["content"], list) else [{"text": i["content"]}]))

    step = runner.Step([{"type":"function_call","name":call["name"],"call_id":"x","arguments":json.dumps(args)}])
    answer = runner.recorded_answer(parent, step)
    if answer is None: print(parent, call["name"], "NO ANSWER"); continue
    a = json.loads(answer)
    if call["name"] == "workspace_inspect":
        print(parent, call["name"], {s: strip_ids(a["result"].get(s)) == strip_ids(real["result"].get(s)) for s in args["sections"]})
    elif call["name"] == "settings_get":
        print(parent, call["name"], [(i["key"], i["value"]) for i in a["result"]["items"]], "==", [(i["key"], i["value"]) for i in real["result"]["items"]], [(i["key"], i["value"]) for i in a["result"]["items"]] == [(i["key"], i["value"]) for i in real["result"]["items"]])
    else:
        print(parent, call["name"], "result equal ignoring ids:", strip_ids(a["result"]) == strip_ids(real["result"]), strip_ids(a["result"]))
EOF
